image_description: A close-up photograph of a bright orange coral fungus (Ramaria or similar genus) growing on a decaying log. The fungus features multiple upright, cylindrical branches that fork near the tips, resembling marine coral. The background consists of blurred dark wood and a single out-of-focus green leaf in the upper right.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific taxonomic classification of the fungus and ensure it is not a misidentified object or generic shape.

Texture realism of the fungal surface

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the tips of the branches. AI generators often struggle with fine, thin extremities, causing them to melt into the background or terminate unnaturally. Verify if the branching logic is biologically plausible (i.e., do branches split logically or do they appear to grow out of nowhere?).
